ios.desc:
Access the most accurate NBA data available completely for free! Whether it's for a research project or sports betting, you can be sure to find the data you need on Locksmith.

Use our points, rebounds, and assists allowed chart to gauge whether any given player's matchup is easy or difficult as well as the defensive strengths and weaknesses of every team. Players with easier matchups generally perform over their averages and vice versa. Using the Dataset Generator, you can download your own NBA datasets and player game logs for your own viewing/research without any hassle. All datasets that you generate are automatically saved to your phone, from where they can be viewed, downloaded, copied, and refreshed. Simply enter a date range, fill out a few optional filters, and you're good to go!

What makes Locksmith unique?
Unlike any other service, Locksmith regularly updates its player information to reflect each player's most up-to-date position and adds new game stats to the dataset every day. This allows for more accurate "stat allowed" charts than anywhere else, guaranteeing the best rankings for you to go off of. Additionally, we uniquely weigh player contributions such that starters' stats are weighed more heavily to better reflect how teams perform against capable opponents at each position. The Dataset Generator is also the only of its kind, combining ease-of-use with zero cost.

quotes.text:
Hey basketball fans and betting enthusiasts!

I’m excited to share an app I’m launching called Locksmith, designed for everyone who loves diving deep into NBA data. Whether you're into sports betting, fantasy leagues, or just a fanatic, Locksmith has something for you.

Why Locksmith?

Up-to-date Data: We update player info and positions daily, ensuring you have the most accurate "stats allowed" charts and rankings.

Unique Analysis: Our charts weigh starter stats more heavily, giving a clearer picture of team performances against top players at each position.

Dataset Generator: Easily create your own datasets with game logs. Enter a date range, add filters, and download data directly to your phone.

Ideal for Research and Betting: Use our app to understand team strengths and weaknesses, find advantageous matchups, and make informed predictions or fantasy picks.

Try it out for free!

No hidden costs or subscriptions. Just quality data at your fingertips.

Website: https://www.locksmithapp.xyz

Download: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/locksmith/id6476451800

Would love to get your feedback and see how Locksmith helps in your NBA analysis and betting strategies.
